preset_info.author: Adam Russin
preset_info.description: Native cyberdeck status widget. Codex workflow inspired by Tooblippe/codex-usage (MIT). Set source to your own endpoint. See repository README and ATTRIBUTION.md.
preset_info.title: CD4.2 / Phosphor Classic

source.title: Source
source.description: Set your own HTTPS usage.json endpoint. No query or fragment; widget adds cache keys.

latch.title: Snapshot
latch.description: Captured request marker and prior quota fields. Do not edit. Starts empty; never sample/live data from the author.

bust.title: FreshURL
bust.description: ON: five-minute URL windows plus manual fetch. OFF: manual nonce and normal app network refresh. Neither is an Android timer.
